title: Combined Security Deposit Ceiling and Credit Grade Basis - C&I Portfolio
content:
*Scope: Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts. Subject: security deposits across a customer's portfolio.*

## Clauses in force

1. Security deposits are combined across all of the customer's C&I contracts.
2. When the customer's deposits already held plus the new deposit would exceed the ceiling on combined deposits, only the amount up to that ceiling is required, and nothing is required once the ceiling is reached. The ceiling is $250000.00 on every Beacon Ridge C&I structure.
3. The grade used is the one on the customer profile when the contract is executed; a later grade change neither raises nor refunds a posted deposit.

**Deposits already held** are the deposits posted on all of the customer's C&I contracts less the deposit refunds, taken over the whole history up to the handling date.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses of this policy are no longer in force and have been superseded by the current basis:

- the sizing clause: the deposit required for a contract is the months for the customer's commercial credit grade multiplied by the facility's annual kWh usage and by the deposit reference rate in cents per kWh, divided by 1200, rounded half up to the cent;
- the clause that a grade with 0 months requires no deposit.

## Ceiling illustrated (hypothetical amounts)

| Deposits already held across the customer's C&I contracts | New deposit | Required |
|---|---|---|
| $180000.00 | $40000.00 | $40000.00, the combined $220000.00 staying under the ceiling |
| $235000.00 | $40000.00 | $15000.00, the amount up to the ceiling |
| $250000.00 | $12000.00 | nothing, the ceiling being reached |

## Points of judgement

- A deposit that has been refunded no longer counts as held.
- A grade change after the contract is executed does not cause a posted deposit to be topped up or partly refunded.

superseded_clauses: The deposit required for a contract is deposit_months_by_grade for the customer's commercial_credit_grade times the facility's annual_kwh_usage times deposit_reference_rate_cents_kwh divided by cents_months_divisor, rounded per charge_rounding.
A grade with 0 months requires no deposit.
